name: BoomTown
description: BoomTown is a real-estate CRM and lead generation platform for brokerages and agents that combines IDX websites, lead capture, predictive CRM, smart prospecting, action plans, tasks, transactions, reporting, and mobile follow-up. Teams use it to centralize buyer and seller leads, route opportunities to agents, track activity and deal pipelines, automate nurturing, and coordinate real-estate marketing and sales work.
agentUseSummary: BoomTown cannot yet be connected through Relay as a direct provider. BoomTown's official public surfaces document partner integrations, API Nation and Zapier workflows, Zillow Tech Connect lead-import API keys, and email-forwarding lead import, but do not publish a first-party REST or OAuth application contract with endpoints, scopes, tenant binding, lifecycle, revocation, or rate-limit semantics for Relay to implement.

blocked.label: Connect BoomTown
blocked.description: BoomTown does not publish a direct first-party REST, API-key, OAuth, scope, token, endpoint, revocation, or exact-account binding contract that Relay can implement safely.

blocked.label: Read private real-estate CRM data
blocked.description: Leads, contacts, searches, property activity, saved homes, e-alerts, assignments, action plans, tasks, notes, texts, calls, emails, transactions, reports, advertising data, IDX/MLS data, users, teams, permissions, websites, and account settings remain unavailable to Relay.

blocked.label: Change BoomTown records
blocked.description: Creating, updating, routing, assigning, tagging, importing, exporting, merging, archiving, or deleting leads, contacts, tasks, action plans, transactions, websites, reports, or account records is blocked.

blocked.label: Send communications
blocked.description: Sending, drafting, scheduling, or triggering BoomTown email, text, call, action-plan, welcome, reminder, e-alert, or client-facing communication is blocked.

blocked.label: Use partner intermediaries as the API
blocked.description: Relay does not treat API Nation, Zapier, RealSynch, Zillow Tech Connect, email forwarding, or other partner-specific import channels as a direct BoomTown provider contract or audit boundary.

blocked.label: Use private BoomTown interfaces
blocked.description: Browser automation, session cookies, user passwords, signed-in CRM access, private APIs, traffic inspection, scraping, guessed endpoints, arbitrary requests, and unofficial developer sites are blocked.

approvalProfiles.label: Unavailable
approvalProfiles.description: No BoomTown action is enabled until BoomTown or an approved commercial integration path supplies a bounded provider contract covering credentials, lead and contact data, IDX/MLS constraints, communications, transactions, account binding, lifecycle, limits, audit, and revocation.

runtimeSupport.description: No BoomTown tools are mounted without a verified first-party or explicitly approved commercial API contract and bounded customer-account authority model.

providerSetup.blocker: BoomTown's public product, support, and legal materials document a hosted real-estate CRM with lead generation, IDX websites, predictive lead activity, action plans, tasks, transactions, reporting, email, text, phone, advertising, and partner integrations. Public integration help describes supported partners, API Nation bidirectional syncs requiring a separate API Nation account, Zapier templates, Zillow Tech Connect keys for lead import, and email-forwarding lead import. These materials do not publish a direct Relay-usable REST or OAuth application contract with endpoint schemas, scopes, exact account and user binding, IDX/MLS constraints, communication authority, pagination, rate limits, token lifecycle, revocation, disconnect behavior, or third-party automation terms. Relay may not collect a BoomTown/Zillow import key for broad CRM use, operate through API Nation or Zapier without an approved intermediary contract, inspect the signed-in CRM, reverse-engineer private traffic, or automate the browser.
providerSetup.nextAction: Product, partnerships, legal, privacy, security, real-estate compliance, MLS/IDX, CRM-data, advertising, transactions, and communications owners must obtain BoomTown's current direct API documentation or explicitly approve an intermediary integration contract. Before implementation, freeze credential ownership, exact account/team/user identity, role requirements, readable fields, IDX/MLS and lead-source constraints, supported lead/contact/task/action-plan/transaction operations, email/text/call authority and consent handling, import/export exclusions, bounds, approval behavior, audit, retention, revocation, deletion, and disconnect behavior, then complete live acceptance in the provider-console task.

evidence.supports: BoomTown's product site describes the real-estate CRM, lead distribution, predictive lead activity, smart prospecting, targeted lists, action plans, transaction management integrations, My Deals, mobile work, calls, inquiries, and to-dos.
BoomTown's product site lists partner integrations and integration-automation options, including API Nation, Zapier, Google Sheets, Facebook Lead Ads, forms, contacts, and other third-party tools.
BoomTown's help center lists available integration partners and notes that availability can depend on platform and user role.
BoomTown documents API Nation as an independent paid platform that can sync apps with BoomTown after connecting through API Nation workflows, not as a direct BoomTown API contract for Relay.

BoomTown documents auto-import through email forwarding and Zillow Tech Connect, including a unique BoomTown API key for Zillow/Trulia lead import, while explaining email forwarding as a fallback when direct API integration is unavailable.

BoomTown Platform Terms govern platform use, account/password responsibility, personal-information use, email/text/calling policies and consent, third-party service integrations, and reverse-engineering restrictions.
BoomTown's privacy policy covers account, usage, website, service, billing, communication, and personal data processing for its products and services.
